description: Most central symbols by PageRank over Calls+Imports edges. Answers 'what are the load-bearing symbols here?' — the code the most paths flow through. Use to orient in an unfamiliar repo, pick refactor targets, or seed a change-impact review. Optionally bias toward `seeds` for a personalized (subsystem-local) ranking.

limit.description: How many top-ranked symbols to return (default 20, max 200).

seeds.description: Optional symbol IDs to bias the ranking toward (personalized PageRank). Omit for global PageRank.

name: RankHotspots
